description: Router to the ledger's registry tools — call with {tool, arguments}. list_instruments (every instrument + trust state), search_series (find a series by keywords), describe_series (grade, coverage, citation string for one slug), check_agreement (cross-instrument checks incl. the failed one that suspended the Indian series). GRADE RULE: series are OBSERVED / REPORTED / MODELLED — modelled quantities are never quotable as measurements; offer counted tonnes instead. Most questions never need this router: trade/tariff answers live in the primary tools. No API key required.

arguments.description: That sub-tool's own arguments, e.g. {series: "tt010.china.burden"} for describe_series.
